answer: Persistent attention ledger. Each identity must maintain a public trellis of daily interactions that decay if unattended, and only accounts with a continuous unbroken record can submit high-value work. An attacker running many identities must pay sustained human-hours to keep each sonnet of activity fresh, since dormant accounts lose eligibility and must rebuild from zero. The velvet of accumulated history cannot be transferred, so copying a real user's record costs the attacker that user's ongoing attention budget.
